summary: Home Estate has five client reviews, useful tools such as a stamp duty calculator and repair request, and a modern look. Missing lead capture and small errors cost enquiries.

findings.problem: No lead capture form or chat appears on the page. The calls to action are generic (Contact Us, Start Here, Read more), and hours show Monday to Friday 9 to 5 only.
findings.cost: A seller or buyer browsing on a weekend has no quick way to ask, and generic buttons do not tell them what happens next.
findings.fix: A short Request an appraisal form and chat on every page, with weekend options.

findings.problem: The contact email shows as [email protected] in the page text, the About menu's Instagram link ends in #, and the Repair Request Submit button links to the team page.
findings.cost: A contact email that cannot be read, a dead social link and a submit button that goes to the wrong page lose enquiries.
findings.fix: A tappable email, correct social links and a form that sends to the right place.

findings.problem: The Sales and Rentals headings appear with no content under them, the team page is linked at two different addresses, and an empty link sits in the page.
findings.cost: Empty sections and duplicate links make an agency look unfinished to a seller choosing between agents.
findings.fix: Content in every section and one address for each page.

findings.problem: The five reviews have no star ratings or dates, and a review has a capitalisation error: and Making the entire process stress-free. Listing cards show 2Beds and 1Baths without spaces.
findings.cost: Undated reviews are easy to doubt, and small errors weaken a premium look.
findings.fix: Dated reviews with ratings, linked to your Google profile, and clean listing cards.

redesign: A seller first homepage with a short appraisal form, chat and weekend contact options.
Proof beside every button: dated reviews with ratings, your named agents and recent results.
Suburb pages written to rank for searches like real estate agent Maroubra and property appraisal Eastern Beaches.
